name: codex
label: Codex CLI
install: Install the Codex CLI (npm i -g @openai/codex) and sign in
_toolPolicy: No per-tool allowlist: the workspace-write sandbox is the boundary, and the recipe's tool list lives only in the prompt's contract.
_argv: --ignore-user-config and --ignore-rules keep the user's own config.toml and execpolicy rules (approval policy, writable roots, plugins, MCP servers) out of a recipe run; the login in CODEX_HOME still applies. approval_policy=never because nobody is there to approve, network access because web and bash recipes fetch, and windows.sandbox=unelevated because without a Windows sandbox mode every shell command fails (read-only on 0.167.0) while file edits still work. Ignored off Windows.
